input.quote: Risk of loss for all Base Components shall at all times remain with IBM. Risk of loss for all Customer Components shall at all times remain with Customer.
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns no results and the section outline contains no insurance provision, so the Agreement is silent on vendor coverage. IBM is a hosting vendor that operates the e-business Hosting Environment and holds Customer Components (§ 14.12) and processes personal information on Customer's behalf (§ 14.18), which triggers the playbook's cyber/privacy requirement and makes the walk-away position (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data) applicable. We inserted a short insurance covenant as new § 14.12A, adjacent to the existing risk-allocation provision in the miscellaneous article, at the preferred levels (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request), with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant after § 14.12 Risk of Loss
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision, so we added our standard coverage requirements (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, and cyber USD 5M since IBM hosts and processes Customer Data and personal data on our behalf under §§ 5.3 and 14.18), plus certificates on request. If needed, we can accept E&O of USD 1M and cyber of USD 2M.

ops.text: IBM shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. IBM shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.
